_comment: THE PASS AT A MID-TURN ROOT (CLAUDE.md hard rule, USER 2026-11-22: "it must always be able to do nothing to end the phase").

MAIN-1 frame of turn 5, the land drop already used: opponent at 4, a settled Keldon Marauders (3/3, can attack), three untapped Mountains, hand Browbeat + a Mountain we cannot play (so we HOLD a card), a TWO-card library.

The only main-1 cast is Browbeat, and the opponent DECLINES it (4 - 3 visible = 1 <= 8): we draw three from a two-card library and LOSE (CR 104.3c). Passing attacks the opponent to 1 and wins next turn.
Before 2026-11-22 the no-drop enumeration held no pass (non-empty subsets only) and the hosts appended one only to an EMPTY list, so the root's only line was the losing Browbeat.
